rows.grounds: gen. sg. m. of asaṅkoca (a- + saṅkoca, non-contraction); describes the agent in L1/L2 context of voluntary-death/yogic practice.
compound tanvādi-kartṛ, nom. sg. m.; agent who creates body and so on, supported by L1/L2 passage on the self as agent.
sandhi tena + īśaḥ; tena (instr./abl. sense 'therefore/by that') + īśa (lord), nom. sg. m.; L1/L2 gives the reason for being called lord.
3rd sg. pass. pres. of √vac; states the designation, supported by L1/L2.
nom. sg. m. pronoun; refers to the subject identified in L1/L2.
compound vāyu-ātman, nom. sg. m.; having the nature of wind/vital air, supported by L1/L2 yogic context.
loc. sg. m./n. of dṛḍha (firm); locative absolute context in L1/L2.
sandhi tasmin + deha-yantre; loc. sg. of tad + loc. sg. of compound deha-yantra (body-machine), supported by L1/L2.
instr. sg. of compound cid-ātman (consciousness-self); indicates manner/identity in L1/L2.
